text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list:
Epi! You're overdoing it, you're overdoing 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Thanks for stopping me!

I know the reason. It's because her 
excitement has been building day by day 
toward the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: What we're doing next is... a race!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Not that, the race!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No, that's wrong!! It's a race!!!!!!!!

...Lately, she's been like this even at 
unrelated times. If I don't let her vent 
her feelings toward racing, it'll end up 
hindering her training...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I want to!!
choice_data_list: Shall we do a mock race then?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I WILL!!!! Just you wait!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I gathered them all!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, warm-up is over~" "Um, with this 
lineup, first I should hold back and—" 
"...I'll crush them all." 
"*Hsssss............*"

They had gathered promising Umamusume with 
graded stakes experience under their belts 
from races like the Asahi Hai FS and 
Hopeful Stakes, all setting their sights 
on the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, something interesting is starting!" 
"Whoa, gotta keep an eye on this...!" 
"...Wait, no Logotype? That's surprising."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...I was invited, yes~. However, my race 
is coming up soon~."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
“Just saying. Alright... let's watch and 
prepare.”

There's quite a crowd, creating an 
atmosphere just like the real deal. I 
never expected it to turn into such a big 
deal...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Lookin' good, right?! After all, I picked 
members I really wanna win with!"
choice_data_list: (...No, maybe it was for the best.)

text_block_list.text:
A high-level clash with her own generation 
should help her sharpen her focus. Plus, 
we can prepare our strategy for the main 
event...
choice_data_list: Alright, now go run your heart out!
Alright, go run with all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for being here today, everyone! 
Let's have a blast!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Epi, do you realize? Everyone here is 
aiming for—you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"A chance to go head-to-head with someone 
in the spotlight... I'm coming at you for 
real, so you better be ready, okay?"
(Waaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Such incredible heat... Wait, Epi-san!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —"Haaaaaaaah!!" "Epi, finish it here...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...! The heat, it's so close...! —Am I 
getting overtaken...?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Epi-san, do your best!

The race heated up, and just as the 
Umamusume were about to surge toward the 
finish line all at once—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I won't lose!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! I won't, I won't! I'll win, 
win, win win win win win—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win thisssssss!! I'm gonna 
wiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHH AAAH AaahAAaaah 
AAAHaaaaaaaAAAAHHH!!!!

It was the first time I had ever seen 
Epiphaneia display such an eerie, 
ferocious drive. She blew right past the 
goal post and just kept running at full 
speed...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, sorry! Looks like I put a bit 
too much into it again!

Standing there was her usual self. None of 
that bizarre intensity from earlier could 
be felt...
choice_data_list:
(If it's just my imagination... that's 
fine, but...)

text_block_list.text:
—However, Epiphaneia was undeniably 
changing.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!!!

Once she starts running, she never stops. 
That part hasn't changed, but...

Completely unable to control themselves, 
they just kept running until all their 
energy and stamina were utterly 
depleted...

Facing Epiphaneia, I asked her if 
something had happened, and—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"There's nothing I can do about it 
either!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"When I run, I remember the race... and a 
wave of heat surges up my back—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The voice of destiny pushes me forward 
with tremendous force...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —"Let's win!!" ...she said!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"When that cheer pushes me forward, my 
legs just won't stop! —Not until every 
last bit of my strength is gone!"

It seems that after a high-level mock 
race, her fighting spirit caught fire... 
and a vicious cycle has emerged where the 
voice of destiny fans those very flames.

"If the same situation happens in a 
race... she will quickly exhaust her 
stamina and won't hold out until the final 
straight. She won't be able to display her 
wonderful talent..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Resist? Not a chance! Sure it's tough, but 
those cheers are a blessing!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Wherever the voice of destiny pushes me 
toward, something good is bound to be 
waiting! There has to be a reason for this 
too...!

I was the one who proposed the mock race. 
Knowing her personality, couldn't I have 
anticipated this happening, even just a 
little...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, it's because I suggested the 
race...

Sorry, it's my fault for suggesting the 
race...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's why, I can definitely get even 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the race, I got to feel 
everyone's true determination early on!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now we can prepare even more for the real 
deal! I'm sure I'll eventually understand 
why those voices push me forward so 
strongly!

...Indeed, looking at it positively, if we 
had gone into the real race without a mock 
race, she might have lost control in the 
Satsuki Sho.

"If this was an inevitable problem, one 
could also view it as a blessing that we 
still have time to counter it precisely 
because it happened now."
choice_data_list:
(That's right, there's no point just 
lamenting!)

text_block_list.text:
There is little time left before our goal, 
the Satsuki Sho. I thought through 
whatever countermeasures we could prepare 
by then—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There's no one here! You mean I get it all 
to myself?!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's run with all our heart right 
here.
Yeah, let's run our hearts out here.

text_block_list.text:
What ignited her fighting spirit was the 
presence of the other Umamusume. So first, 
I tried creating an environment where she 
could focus alone—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Ngh, it's driving me crazy!! Taking these 
earplugs out!"
choice_data_list: Try it just a little bit longer!

text_block_list.text:
"I tried using earplugs so I wouldn't hear 
the voice of destiny, but—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny is telling me to 
take it off too! Uwooooh!!"
choice_data_list:
(...I guess this is crossing the line 
after all!)

text_block_list.text:
The trial and error continues. Hoping that 
the fighting spirit sprouting within 
Epiphaneia moves in the right direction—
